utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 9 on Saturday at the front porch still works for me. I can help get the repair drive set up, just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli. Could you bring a tape measure and a basic tool kit, and I’ll handle the rest at the front porch Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up a few more folks for the repair drive, so if you know anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’m still lining up helpers for Tess’s repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll send anyone free your way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks for checking. If you can bring a hammer and a box of screws, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring those. Do you still need anything else for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep pointing people your way as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll keep an eye on the setup details. If there’s anything you want me to bring, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 9 on Saturday at the front porch still works for me, and I can help get the repair drive set up. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. I’ll bring my usual tools, and if you think of anything else we’re short on, just tell me before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll count on you Saturday at the front porch for Tess’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You can count on me, Vik. I’ll be there at 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Oren, I’ve got you and Sam both set for Saturday at the front porch. I’ll have a few jobs lined up so you can jump right in when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Tess. I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch and ready to help however you need.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
